raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/MainWindow: SB redesign: Omi-mark avatar on replies that spins while thinking (typing-dots suppressed for Omi's own replies) and tool-call chips gated to the streaming turn, merged with main's metadata-row reveal honoring keyboard focus (shared FocusState + testable ChatBubbleMetadataReveal); a component split is tracked follow-up.

Merging the Canonical Memory Atlas (rollout-gated full-page exploration view reachable from Memories, its own top-bar suppression) with main's DesktopTopBar redesign pushed the combined `mainContent` SwiftUI expression past the type checker's budget; split into `sidebarSlot`/`mainContentContainer`/staged notification-chain properties so each stays independently type-checkable. Follow-up: routing the Memory hub's Brain Map destination through MemoryGraphPresentationMode so canonical-cohort users get the atlas there instead of the legacy graph, plus the destination-local lifecycle load that establishes the cohort capability when Memories was never opened. Merging main's unified Memory navigation (#10541) carries in its hub-destination binding and readable-width adaptiveContent wrapper alongside this branch's atlas page state; a component split is tracked follow-up.
SearchableDropdown category filter plus extracted filter helpers for regression coverage.

Home ask bar now auto-grows as a multi-line TextField so long messages wrap instead of scrolling off-screen (+14 lines over the prior SB-redesign home/chat layout); a component split is tracked follow-up.

Bridge memory search now awaits the active initial or pagination projection before refreshing, preventing an immediate post-navigation marker search from using stale lifecycle capability state; merged with the rollout-gated Canonical Atlas inline entry point, which replaces the legacy Brain Map card main removed from this list.

Adds CanonicalMemoryAtlasTabView (header-less hub-tab presentation), the single-active-type layout and small-atlas label/mark policies that keep a sparse atlas legible, and a deterministic single-type export fixture for that case. The private atlas surface and logger keep all of it in this file; splitting the surface from the layout engine is tracked follow-up. Also adds the sparse-atlas label flip (a name colliding below its mark is retried above instead of dropped, which on the real account recovered 8 of 10 anonymous entities) and the extracted nodeLabel it shares.
Suggested-task loading feedback is now overlaid outside the list flow so an initial fetch cannot shift the task rows; a component split is tracked follow-up.
SB redesign: adds the hover-expand AppNavRail (icons→labels) and the merged/simplified navigation (Memory, Insights) driving selectedIndex; a component split is tracked follow-up.
